project_type: Multi-module Maven monorepo (Java Spring Boot backend services) + React/TypeScript frontend (Vite + vitest)
build_system: Maven multi-module (root pom.xml). NO Maven wrapper present (xamops-service/mvnw does NOT exist) — use system `mvn`. Frontend uses npm + Vite; build script is `npm run build` = `icons:bundle && tsc && vite build`.
test_framework: JUnit 5 + Mockito + AssertJ for xamops-service; vitest for frontend-app.
build_command: Backend: `mvn -pl xamops-service -am -q -DskipTests compile`. Frontend type-check: `cd frontend-app && npx tsc --noEmit`.
test_command: Backend targeted: `mvn -pl xamops-service test -Dtest=<ClassName>`. Frontend: `cd frontend-app && npx vitest run`.
verification_instructions: 1) Backend compile must exit 0. 2) Run new + related backend tests, expect Failures:0 Errors:0. 3) Frontend `npx tsc --noEmit` exits 0. 4) `npx vitest run` — no NEW failures vs the pre-existing unrelated ones documented in .agents/tasks/finalize-exchange-rate/verification.md (cloudk8sSidebar, loginAsAccountDashboard, BillOpsAdminDashboardPage, EksDetailsPage, K8sDataTable). Clean up any temp files.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None required for this task. (Some backend DTO-shape tests capture snapshots with -Dlobtext.captureDtoFields=true, but only touch billops/admin dashboard; not expected here. If a DTO-shape test fails due to an added field, regenerate with that flag and restore the header note, as finalize-exchange-rate did.)
environment_constraints: No live cloud credentials in CI; tests must mock GCP/Azure clients (see GcpPricingCurrencyTest constructor-mock pattern). Do not add a live FX feed — currency rate is config-driven (currency.usd-to-inr-rate, default 83.0) and is exactly what we are removing from the GCP unified path. Do not commit machine-specific absolute Java paths to .vscode/settings.json (CI fails PRs that do — see CONTRIBUTING.md).
contribution_requirements: CONTRIBUTING.md: keep .vscode/settings.json portable (no absolute java.*.home). Keep changes minimal and scoped to unified-dashboard currency correctness; do not refactor unrelated code. Commit locally on branch fix/unified-dashboard-currency; never push.
key_patterns: Azure already solved this exact problem and is the template: AzureDashboardData exposes `currency` (native ISO code, null=unknown) and `monthToDateSpendUsd` (USD from Azure's own CostUSD, null when unavailable); mapAzureDataToDashboardData sets MTD = monthToDateSpendUsd ?? native and logs a warn when a non-USD subscription has no USD; the frontend useUnifiedDashboard.ts no longer converts Azure (`azureData = azureQuery.data ?? null`). GCP must follow the same shape. GCP billed-rate USD source: the standard billing export column currency_conversion_rate (USD->local), so cost / currency_conversion_rate = USD; GcpCostService.getProjectCurrencyCode(projectId) already reads the `currency` column (returns USD on failure). GcpBillingSql.NET_COST_SUM is SUM(CAST(cost AS NUMERIC)) + credits in native currency. GcpPricingService/GcpOptimizationService already return USD (GcpPricingCurrencyTest) — do NOT convert savings/waste.

xamops-service/src/main/java/com/xammer/cloud/service/gcp/GcpCostService.java (getUnfilteredMonthToDateSpendSync ~L396 is the native MTD query to mirror for a USD variant; getProjectCurrencyCode ~L1053; getBillingTableName; getHistoricalCosts)
